scope: Only historical scans or archival studio photographs of real prints. No quality or pose augmentation was applied to the source crops. Pose evaluation may apply diagnostic exact right-angle turns. History and studio materials differ from a present-day scan through a plastic sleeve. No crops from designated segmentation release, calibration or orientation development sources.
source_asset_description: Source JPEG hashes cover the exact downloaded 1400-pixel-wide IIIF archive derivatives, not an unverified full-size master. Lossless PNG crops do not apply blur, retouching, perspective warp or synthetic effects.
